items.title: How Eon built multi-cloud investigation with an MCP Gateway on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Learn how Eon replaced per-tool credentials and local MCP processes across AWS, GCP, and Azure with a single authenticated Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway, giving more than 100 developers and autonomous agents unified access to production investigation and cutting new-engineer onboarding from two days to two minutes.
items.creator: Dor Shaboy

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Denodo and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Build a governed semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with the Denodo Platform and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It federates Amazon Aurora, Amazon Redshift, and an on-premises PostgreSQL database into a single customer 360 view an agent queries in VQL, with identity propagation and row- and column-level access control enforced at the semantic layer.
items.creator: Suntosh Murthy

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with Strategy Mosaic and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: The third post in our semantic-layer series builds a customer 360 across Amazon Redshift and Amazon Aurora with Strategy Mosaic, exposes it to a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore through the Mosaic MCP server, and enforces per-user row and column security end-to-end.
items.creator: Zhili Cheng

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI on AWS with AtScale and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: The third post in our semantic-layer series builds a governed customer 360 model on Amazon Redshift with AtScale, then exposes it to a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore through the AtScale MCP server. Identity propagation, RBAC, row security, and full query audit are enforced at the semantic layer, not the prompt.
items.creator: Frank Lapolito
